title: An App Is Free Because An Administrator Said So
description: จนถึงเวอร์ชันก่อนหน้า หน้าราคาพิมพ์ชื่อแอปที่สมาชิกใช้ฟรีไว้ในโค้ด และเชิงอรรถก็พิมพ์ชื่อแอปที่จำกัดสิทธิ์ไว้เช่นกัน เป็นคำแถลงต่อสาธารณะที่ไม่มีใครเป็นเจ้าของ รอบนี้ย้ายคำแถลงนั้นมาอยู่ในทะเบียนแอปที่ผู้ดูแลเป็นผู้ประกาศ พร้อมหน้า /admin/apps ที่บังคับเหตุผลและเขียน audit ทุกครั้ง หน้าสาธารณะ fail closed คืออ่านฐานข้อมูลไม่ได้แล้วไม่เอ่ยชื่อแอปใดเลย
scope: add announced_at and announced_by to apps, so an announcement is an act with an owner rather than a side effect of a row existing
route every read and write of the registry through one module, so no page queries the apps table itself
build /admin/apps from the card primitives, with a mandatory reason and an audit event per announcement and per revocation
derive the member-free app list and the restricted-app footnote on /pricing from the registry, naming no app in source
refuse to mark a member_free app as open until a path exists that actually issues the entitlement
close the app entry page when the registry says an app is not open, while an unreadable database keeps the previous behaviour
rename platform.ts access to seededAccess, so a default stops reading as a declaration
verification: pnpm test, typecheck and lint pass
a planted app name inside the pricing copy turns the new assertion red, then reverts clean
an announcement, a revocation and a refused member_free open are each exercised against a real database through the back office
rollback: กลับไป tag v0.33.0-closed-tables-by-test migration 0006 เพิ่มคอลัมน์ nullable สองตัว ถอยได้โดยไม่เสียข้อมูล แถวที่ประกาศไปแล้วจะค้างอยู่โดยไม่มีใครอ่าน
constraints: An announcement is a statement, never a grant. What a member may actually use is decided by app_entitlements and nothing else.
The registry is the single switchboard. A second flag mechanism for the same app would be two switches on one lamp.
Revoking an announcement clears announced_at and never deletes the row, because app_entitlements.app_id cascades.

items.title: Scope member_free to the apps an administrator has announced, moving the list out of platform.ts into the apps registry
Route the landing page and /market app labels through the registry too, so a seeded default stops being a public claim anywhere
Issue a member_free entitlement when a member enters an app the registry announces as free, so an announcement can become an open app
Prove by source scan that the back office reads no column of a closed table, and that the scanner itself can fail
Build the pricing and promotion editors behind the administrator check, writing an audit event per change
Open payment collection: choose a provider, tie a settled invoice to an entitlement state, and write the ADR that governs it
Move the access tier copy out of source and into content the back-office owns
Decide whether trial entitlements issued under the five-day term are migrated to seven days
Show in the estimate where a Factor F came from: printed step or interpolation, and the two steps it sits between
Give the product a way to tell that the Factor F and labour circulars it holds are still the current ones
Bring the ว480 labour rate schedule in as a dataset, keeping the conditions that change a rate (quantity bands, area, method) as data rather than notes
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table
Record ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ and ประมาณราคาโดย on the estimate so the sheet header can be filled
Retire takeoff_items.category once headings carry the same meaning
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 against the Comptroller General's Department, which ว499 and ว481 confirm is the issuing authority
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
Give roadmap item ids a single owner: IP-059 was issued twice, in v0.18.0 and again in v0.20.0, for unrelated work
